tags.title: Buttons
tags.summary: A native button with Framework presentation: size, appearance, colour role or status, optional start and end icons, spacing and radius. loading sets aria-busy and disables it against repeated activation.

attributes.name: appearance
attributes.description: How the button looks. Surface reads the neutral alpha ramp: a faint fill and a border. ghost is the link appearance under its old name (compat until 2026-12-01).

attributes.name: aria-label
attributes.description: Accessible label for icon-only or custom buttons.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Disabled state flag.

attributes.name: icon
attributes.description: Single icon name shortcut.

attributes.name: icon-end
attributes.description: Logical end icon name.

attributes.name: icon-left
attributes.description: Compatibility alias for icon-start.

attributes.name: icon-position
attributes.description: Placement for the single icon shortcut.

attributes.name: icon-right
attributes.description: Compatibility alias for icon-end.

attributes.name: icon-start
attributes.description: Logical start icon name.

attributes.name: loading
attributes.description: Loading state flag.

attributes.name: native-type
attributes.description: Native button type attribute.

attributes.name: radius
attributes.description: Border radius modifier.

attributes.name: root-class
attributes.description: Extra classes applied to the inner button element.

attributes.name: scheme
attributes.description: Which colour family the control takes. What the control is about is the status axis; a status set there wins over this.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Button size token.

attributes.name: spacing
attributes.description: Semantic internal spacing profile.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: What the control is about, in the shared status vocabulary. The only one a control paints today is `error`, the destructive one: a control that deletes, discards or cannot be undone.

attributes.name: template
attributes.description: Template variant name for SfBaseElement external templates.

attributes.name: text
attributes.description: Visible button text when no text slot is provided.

attributes.name: tightness
attributes.description: Compatibility alias for spacing.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Legacy name for appearance, still honoured. See contracts/public-api-axes.json.

tags.title: Checkbox
tags.summary: A native checkbox with a label, Framework presentation and checked, indeterminate and disabled states kept in step between the host attributes and the inner input.

attributes.name: aria-label
attributes.description: Accessible name for a checkbox rendered without a visible label.

attributes.name: error
attributes.description: Invalid state; the native input publishes aria-invalid.

attributes.name: indeterminate
attributes.description: Mixed visual state for a checkbox that summarizes related options.

attributes.name: position
attributes.description: Logical placement of the indicator relative to its text.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Checkbox size token.

tags.title: Close
tags.summary: The decorative cross glyph of a close action, sized on the control ladder. It is aria-hidden and never focusable; the containing native button owns the action and its name.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Decorative close-glyph size token.

tags.title: Context Menu
tags.summary: The Framework's action menu: data entries with icon, caption, value, shortcut, check, submenu, separator and heading, opened by openFor() into the top layer, anchored, with keyboard, typeahead and focus return. A host may still render its own items and own the lifecycle.

attributes.name: active-tab
attributes.description: The chosen tab's id or index; the host renders that tab's rows into the content slot.

attributes.name: closable
attributes.description: A close button at the end of the panel's head.

attributes.name: entries
attributes.description: The menu as data (set as a property, or JSON in the attribute). See item_contract. When present, it replaces items and the content slot.

attributes.name: popup
attributes.description: Not drawn until opened through openFor(). A menu without it is drawn in place, as before.

attributes.name: position
attributes.description: Deprecated: a menu has no tail since 1.3.0 (owner, 2026-10-12); the value is kept for its class and draws nothing.

deprecated.replacement: openFor(anchor, {side, align}) places the menu; no tail is drawn

attributes.name: search
attributes.description: {placeholder, empty, remote}: a search field above the rows (set as a property). Local by default; with remote: true the menu raises sf-context-menu-search {query} and shows the entries the host sets. A submenu entry passes it with `search`.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: The menu's size: rows as tall as a field of that size (32px at 1/2, 40px at 1), its text, insets, search and footer. A submenu takes its parent's size.

attributes.name: tabs
attributes.description: A panel with tabs: labels separated by |, or [{id, label}] as a property. The head (tabs and the close button) and the footer never scroll, the body does, and the panel keeps a fixed width (a ladder step, or width) whatever a tab holds.

attributes.name: tooltip
attributes.description: Deprecated: a menu has no tail since 1.3.0 (owner, 2026-10-12); the value is kept for its class and draws nothing.

deprecated.replacement: none: a menu has no tail

attributes.name: width
attributes.description: How wide openFor() opens the menu: content (its longest line, between --sf-context-menu--min-inline-size and --sf-context-menu--max-inline-size), trigger (exactly the control that opened it; a long line ends in an ellipsis) or a CSS length. openFor(anchor, {width}) overrides it.

tags.title: Datepicker
tags.summary: Accessible date and date-range picker with popup and inline presentation, calendar navigation and host-owned values.

attributes.name: close-on-select
attributes.description: Close the panel once a date (or a range end) is chosen.

attributes.name: context
attributes.description: Which grid the panel opens on: days (empty), month or year.

attributes.name: date
attributes.description: The ISO date (yyyy-mm-dd) chosen; value is read when date is absent.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Disable the field and the panel.

attributes.name: end-value
attributes.description: Range only: the ISO end date.

attributes.name: format
attributes.description: How the date is shown in the field, e.g. DD.MM.YYYY. The value stays ISO.

attributes.name: icon-start
attributes.description: The icon at the start of the field; the canonical name for left-icon.

attributes.name: input
attributes.description: Draw the text field; without it only the panel is drawn.

attributes.name: input-name
attributes.description: The form field name of the value; wins over name.

attributes.name: input-root-class
attributes.description: Classes added to the field's root.

attributes.name: input-size
attributes.description: Legacy name for size, still honoured; size wins when both are set. See contracts/public-api-axes.json.

attributes.name: input-type
attributes.description: The field's appearance (bordered by default), as on sf-inputs.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: The field's visible label.

attributes.name: left-icon
attributes.description: Legacy name for icon-start, still honoured; icon-start wins when both are set.

attributes.name: locale
attributes.description: The language of month and day names; defaults to the page language.

attributes.name: mask
attributes.description: Mask what can be typed in the field to the format.

attributes.name: mask-lazy
attributes.description: Show the mask's placeholder characters only as they are typed.

attributes.name: mask-options
attributes.description: Further mask options as JSON, passed to the field's mask.

attributes.name: mask-pattern
attributes.description: Input mask; when not set it is derived from format, so the default format DD.MM.YYYY gives 00.00.0000.

attributes.name: mask-placeholder-char
attributes.description: The character that stands for a position not yet typed.

attributes.name: max-date
attributes.description: The latest ISO date that can be chosen; later days are disabled.

attributes.name: min-date
attributes.description: The earliest ISO date that can be chosen; earlier days are disabled.

attributes.name: month
attributes.description: The month shown when the panel opens, 0-11; defaults to the chosen date's month, else the current one.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The form field name of the value. input-name is the same and wins when both are set.

attributes.name: open
attributes.description: Whether the panel is open.

attributes.name: placeholder
attributes.description: The field's placeholder text.

attributes.name: portal
attributes.description: Draw the panel at the end of the document so no clipping ancestor cuts it.

attributes.name: preset
attributes.description: The chosen quick range's id. Set by a host it wins over start-value and end-value, and a relative one is resolved against today in the person's time zone when drawn; nothing is emitted for it.

attributes.name: presets
attributes.description: Range only: quick ranges beside the grid. Built-in ids, comma separated (today, yesterday, last-7-days, last-30-days, this-week, this-month, last-month), or as a property [{id, label, relative} | {id, label, range: [from, to]}]. Clamped to min-date and max-date; a range with nothing left is disabled.

attributes.name: range
attributes.description: Pick a start and an end instead of one date.

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: Mark the field required in its form.

attributes.name: root-class
attributes.description: Classes added to the component's root.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Form size of the field.

attributes.name: start-value
attributes.description: Range only: the ISO start date.

attributes.name: template
attributes.description: Which template draws it.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The ISO date (yyyy-mm-dd). As a property, [start, end] for a range; the attribute is the same as date.

attributes.name: week-start
attributes.description: The first day of the week, 0 Sunday to 6 Saturday (1 Monday). Without the attribute it follows the page's language (ru: Monday, en-US: Sunday, ar-EG: Saturday).

attributes.name: year
attributes.description: The year shown when the panel opens; defaults to the chosen date's year, else the current one.

tags.title: Dropdown
tags.summary: Accessible single or multiple selection control with searchable options and optional portal projection.

attributes.name: appearance
attributes.description: How the dropdown looks: a filled field or an outlined one.

attributes.name: columns
attributes.description: How many options a row holds in the grid layout. Ignored in a list.

attributes.name: layout
attributes.description: How the options are laid out. A list is one option a row; a grid puts several in a row, which is the only way a hundred glyphs can be looked at -- a column of them is a column nobody scrolls to the end of. In a grid an option shows its picture and keeps its text as the name a search reads and a pointer sees.

attributes.name: multiple
attributes.description: Allow several values while preserving their serialized selection order. Tag mode is multiple by default.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Native form field name for the selected machine value.

attributes.name: options
attributes.description: Options given as data instead of as sf-list-item children: [{text, value, type?, size?, icon?, selected?, disabled?, colorClass?, avatarImageUrl?, avatarTitle?, ariaLabel?, group?}]. A string or a number is taken as both the label and the value. A parent that renders this dropdown from a template passes its options this way, because capturing child elements means removing them, and the parent can then no longer put a changed list back. Options carrying the same `group`, one after another, are drawn under one heading, so a long list says where each stretch of it comes from instead of repeating that in every row.

attributes.name: portal
attributes.description: Anchor the popup with the shared Framework positioning (SF.Position): native top layer, flip, shift and viewport-limited height. On by default; portal="false" keeps the in-flow list.

attributes.name: search-placeholder
attributes.description: Empty: the text of the page's language ("Search" in English).

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Legacy name for appearance, still honoured. See contracts/public-api-axes.json.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Selected machine value, or a comma-separated list of values for multiple selection.

tags.title: Icons
tags.summary: Semantic Material Symbol wrapper with exact Loader tracking, accessible decorative or informative modes and token-owned geometry.

tags.title: Icon Buttons
tags.summary: Native icon-only action with token geometry, accessible naming and shared loading semantics.

attributes.name: appearance
attributes.description: How the icon button looks. Surface and ghost read the neutral alpha ramp: surface keeps a faint fill and a border, ghost keeps nothing until it is hovered or focused.

attributes.name: aria-label
attributes.description: Accessible label.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Disabled state flag.

attributes.name: filled
attributes.description: Use the filled glyph axis for the standard icon variant.

attributes.name: icon
attributes.description: Material icon name.

attributes.name: kind
attributes.description: What the icon button is: an ordinary icon action or a close control.

attributes.name: loading
attributes.description: Loading state flag.

attributes.name: native-type
attributes.description: Native button type attribute.

attributes.name: radius
attributes.description: Border radius modifier.

attributes.name: root-class
attributes.description: Extra classes applied to the inner icon button element.

attributes.name: scheme
attributes.description: Which colour family the control takes. What the control is about is the status axis; a status set there wins over this.

attributes.name: segment
attributes.description: Joined-control position owned by Button Group composition.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Icon button size token.

attributes.name: spacing
attributes.description: Semantic internal spacing profile.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: What the control is about, in the shared status vocabulary. The only one a control paints today is `error`, the destructive one: a control that deletes, discards or cannot be undone.

attributes.name: template
attributes.description: Template variant name for SfBaseElement external templates.

attributes.name: tightness
attributes.description: Compatibility alias for spacing.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Legacy name for appearance, still honoured. See contracts/public-api-axes.json.

attributes.name: variant
attributes.description: Legacy name for kind, still honoured. See contracts/public-api-axes.json.

tags.title: Inputs
tags.summary: A native single-line form control with Framework presentation, validation messaging and optional mask integration.

attributes.name: appearance
attributes.description: How the field looks: a bordered box, a filled one, or hidden.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Legacy name for appearance, still honoured. See contracts/public-api-axes.json.

tags.title: Pagination
tags.summary: Source-driven navigation for a collection split into numbered pages.

attributes.name: action
attributes.description: Selected batch-action value.

attributes.name: action-apply-text
attributes.description: Label of the batch-action apply button. Empty: the text of the page's language ("Apply" in English).

attributes.name: action-choose-label
attributes.description: Placeholder of the batch-action selector, shown until an action is chosen. Empty: the text of the page's language ("Choose an action" in English).

attributes.name: action-for-all
attributes.description: Current all-items toggle value.

attributes.name: action-for-all-label
attributes.description: Label of the all-items toggle. Empty: the text of the page's language ("For all" in English).

attributes.name: actions
attributes.description: Pipe-separated compatible batch-action definitions.

attributes.name: actions-label
attributes.description: Accessible name of the batch-action selector. Empty: the text of the page's language ("Action for the selected records" in English).

attributes.name: actions-region-label
attributes.description: Accessible name of the panel that appears while rows are marked. Empty: the text of the page's language ("Actions for the selected" in English).

attributes.name: aria-label
attributes.description: Accessible name of the navigation landmark. Empty: the text of the page's language ("Result pages" in English).

attributes.name: bottom
attributes.description: Allow the compatible batch-action section.

attributes.name: bottom-class
attributes.description: Framework utility classes for the batch-action section.

attributes.name: can-count
attributes.description: Whether the host can count on request. Without it the view offers nothing and asks for nothing.

attributes.name: clear-selection-label
attributes.description: Accessible name and tooltip of the control that drops the selection. Empty: the text of the page's language ("Clear the selection" in English).

attributes.name: count-known
attributes.description: Whether the number of records is known. A host that does not count every answer sets it false, and the view offers the number instead of showing it.

attributes.name: counting
attributes.description: A count is on its way; the view shows a short wait in place of the number.

attributes.name: counting-label
attributes.description: Accessible name of the short wait shown while the count is on its way. Empty: the text of the page's language ("Counting" in English).

attributes.name: current
attributes.description: Current one-based page number.

attributes.name: first-label
attributes.description: Accessible name and tooltip of the control that goes to the first page. Empty: the text of the page's language ("First" in English).

attributes.name: has-next
attributes.description: Whether a further page exists. It is what moves forward and Show more when no total was sent.

attributes.name: last-label
attributes.description: Visible label of the compatible last-page action. Empty: the text of the page's language ("Last" in English).

attributes.name: main-class
attributes.description: Framework utility classes for the navigation section.

attributes.name: middle
attributes.description: Show page navigation and collection summary.

attributes.name: next-label
attributes.description: Accessible name of the next-page action. Empty: the text of the page's language ("Next page" in English).

attributes.name: page-field-label
attributes.description: Label of the field that takes a page number. Empty: the text of the page's language ("Page:" in English).

attributes.name: page-label
attributes.description: Accessible prefix for a numbered page action. Empty: the text of the page's language ("Page" in English).

attributes.name: page-size
attributes.description: Positive number of items per page.

attributes.name: page-size-label
attributes.description: Visible and accessible label of the page-size selector. Empty: the text of the page's language ("Per page:" in English).

attributes.name: page-sizes
attributes.description: Comma-separated positive page-size choices.

attributes.name: pages-label
attributes.description: Visible label before page controls. Empty: the text of the page's language ("Pages:" in English).

attributes.name: previous-label
attributes.description: Accessible name of the previous-page action. Empty: the text of the page's language ("Previous page" in English).

attributes.name: selected-count
attributes.description: Selected item count, clamped between zero and total.

attributes.name: selected-label
attributes.description: Visible label for the selected item count. Empty: the text of the page's language ("Selected:" in English).

attributes.name: show-action-for-all
attributes.description: Show the compatible all-items toggle.

attributes.name: show-actions
attributes.description: Show batch actions when actions are supplied.

attributes.name: show-count-label
attributes.description: Text of the control that asks the host for the number. Empty: the text of the page's language ("Show the number" in English).

attributes.name: show-more-busy
attributes.description: Mark the Show more control as working while the host fetches the next portion; it is disabled and shows a loader.

attributes.name: show-more-text
attributes.description: Label of the compatible show-more action. Empty: the text of the page's language ("Show more" in English).

attributes.name: show-page-size
attributes.description: Show the page-size selector for a non-empty collection.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: The step of the size ladder its fields, buttons, labels and page numbers take: 1, or the dense 1/2 of an admin.

attributes.name: template
attributes.description: Template name.

attributes.name: top
attributes.description: Show the compatible show-more section.

attributes.name: top-class
attributes.description: Framework utility classes for the show-more section.

attributes.name: total
attributes.description: Non-negative total item count.

attributes.name: total-label
attributes.description: Visible label for the total item count. Empty: the text of the page's language ("Total:" in English).

tags.title: Spinner
tags.summary: Indeterminate waiting indicator with arc or dots presentation, optional polite status announcement and Framework-owned motion.

attributes.name: kind
attributes.description: What the spinner is: an arc or a row of dots.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Empty: the text of the page's language ("Loading..." in English).

attributes.name: variant
attributes.description: Legacy name for kind, still honoured. See contracts/public-api-axes.json.

tags.title: Tabs
tags.summary: A tab list that shows one local panel at a time, with text or icon tabs given as attributes, slots or data, roving keyboard focus and linked tab panels.

attributes.name: configurable
attributes.description: A gear at the end of the tabs («Настроить вкладки») opens the standard menu with the tabs as a sortable list, a visibility checkbox per tab (pinned tabs fixed) and «Сбросить» in its footer. The choice is the host's: sf-tabs-settings-change {order, hidden}, sf-tabs-settings-reset, setSettings({order, hidden}).

attributes.name: items
attributes.description: An item (set with setItems) may carry key (a stable id for the settings; the index otherwise), icon, count (a small counter after the label), href (the tab is a link: activating it goes to the address; aria-current=page on the active one) and pinned (never hidden, fixed in the settings).

attributes.name: overflow
attributes.description: What the tabs do when they do not fit: scroll (the row scrolls), wrap (rows wrap), or more (the tabs that do not fit go into a trailing «Ещё (n)» menu; the active one always stays).

attributes.name: scheme
attributes.description: Built-in button appearance: default, outline or link. Historical name retained; this is not a semantic color selector. Custom templates may interpret it separately.

tags.title: Tags
tags.summary: Compact static, selectable and removable labels with one explicit interaction owner.

attributes.name: active
attributes.description: Selected state of a checkbox tag.

attributes.name: appearance
attributes.description: Visual appearance, read from the neutral alpha ramp and separate from type: surface keeps a faint fill and a boundary, ghost keeps nothing until it is hovered. Only the neutral types take it, because a status tag carries its meaning in its colour.

attributes.name: aria-label
attributes.description: Optional accessible name override for a selectable tag.

attributes.name: avatar-image-url
attributes.description: Avatar image URL; the visible text remains the accessible label.

attributes.name: avatar-status
attributes.description: Reserved avatar status value for compatible templates.

attributes.name: avatar-text
attributes.description: Avatar initials fallback.

attributes.name: closable

attributes.name: close-label
attributes.description: Accessible name of the remove action. Defaults to Remove, or Удалить on a Russian page.

attributes.name: color-class
attributes.description: Framework semantic background utility for the color marker.

attributes.name: count
attributes.description: Optional count shown with the default tag.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Disable interactive toggle and close actions.

attributes.name: icon
attributes.description: Decorative Framework icon name.

attributes.name: inline
attributes.description: Sit on the text line of another control: no block padding, a flush label, and a remove button the height of the line. The host may publish --sf-tag--line.

attributes.name: interactive
attributes.description: Render the label as a button next to the remove action, for tags that open something (for example a filter chip menu); ignored for checkbox tags.

attributes.name: kind
attributes.description: What the tag carries: a checkbox, an icon, a colour, an avatar, or nothing but its label. The compatibility input quantity is still accepted and means default.

attributes.name: line
attributes.description: Takes the text line of this form size as an inline tag one size down, for a table cell, so the row keeps its control height. Overrides size and inline.

attributes.name: root-class
attributes.description: Framework utility classes for the visible root.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Framework size token: sets the label text and the default spacing.

attributes.name: spacing
attributes.description: Block padding of a free-standing tag, with the names the buttons use.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: What the tag reports, in the shared status vocabulary. Leave it empty for a tag that reports nothing.

attributes.name: template

attributes.name: text
attributes.description: Visible tag label.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Legacy name that answered both questions from one list: a content word reaches kind, a status word reaches status. See contracts/public-api-axes.json.
